articles.title_en: The real effects of monetary shocks: Evidence from micro pricing moments
articles.title_cn: 货币冲击的实际效应：来自微观定价矩的证据
articles.abstract_en: Empirically, what pricing moments are informative about monetary non-neutrality? The frequency of price changes is robustly informative among a set of pricing moments and across specifications: A lower frequency is statistically significantly associated with higher monetary non-neutrality, in line with models of price rigidities. Other moments that describe the price change distribution are not consistently or significantly related to monetary non-neutrality. While the frequency explains the largest share of variation in non-neutrality, no pricing moments individually or jointly explain a majority of the variation in a linear empirical setting. Non-pricing moments explain additional variation, however are not consistently associated with monetary non-neutrality. A multi-sector menu cost model featuring different price adjustment technologies across sectors can rationalize our main findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 实证上，哪些定价矩对货币非中性具有信息量？在一组定价矩和不同规格中，价格调整频率具有稳健的信息量：较低的频率与较高的货币非中性在统计上显著相关，这与价格刚性模型一致。描述价格变化分布的其他矩与货币非中性的关系不一致或不显著。虽然频率解释了非中性变异的最大份额，但在线性实证设定中，没有任何定价矩单独或联合解释非中性变异的大部分。非定价矩解释了额外的变异，但与货币非中性的关联并不一致。一个具有跨部门不同价格调整技术的多部门菜单成本模型可以合理化我们的主要发现。

articles.title_cn: 金融异质性与货币联盟
articles.abstract_en: During the 2010–12 eurozone crisis, deviations of price and wage dynamics from those implied by canonical Phillips curves were systematically related to differences in financial strains across countries. Most notably, markups in financially “weak” (periphery) countries rose, while those in financially “strong” (core) countries declined. In a monetary union model, where financial frictions interact with the firms’ pricing decisions because of customer-market considerations, firms in the periphery maintain cashflows in response to an adverse financial shock by raising markups in both domestic and export markets, while firms in the core reduce markups, undercutting their financially constrained competitors to gain market share. In this framework, a unilateral fiscal-devaluation-style policy by the periphery stabilizes the local economy by improving the condition of firm balance sheets and by boosting household demand—it does not, however, reverse the real exchange rate appreciation in the periphery.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2010-12年欧元区危机期间，价格和工资动态偏离经典菲利普斯曲线所隐含的水平，这种偏离与各国金融压力的差异系统性相关。最显著的是，金融“弱”（外围）国家的加成率上升，而金融“强”（核心）国家的加成率下降。在一个货币联盟模型中，由于客户市场考量，金融摩擦与企业定价决策相互作用，外围国家企业为应对不利金融冲击，通过提高国内和出口市场的加成率来维持现金流，而核心国家企业则降低加成率，以低于其受金融约束的竞争对手的价格来获取市场份额。在这一框架下，外围国家单方面的财政贬值式政策通过改善企业资产负债表状况和提振家庭需求来稳定本地经济——然而，这并不能逆转外围国家实际汇率的升值。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous beliefs and the Phillips curve
articles.title_cn: 异质性信念与菲利普斯曲线
articles.abstract_en: Heterogeneous beliefs modify the New Keynesian Phillips curve by introducing a term in the cross-section distribution of expectations. To take that model to the data, we develop a novel functional data approach to estimation and inference that accounts for variation in distributions of expectations. We find that this variation may be summarized using a handful of functional factors, and demonstrate their statistical and economic relevance for inflation dynamics. Our results are among the first to highlight the potential benefits to be gained in empirical work from a rigorous treatment of diverse beliefs in the study of macroeconomic outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 异质性信念通过引入预期横截面分布的一项来修正新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线。为了将该模型应用于数据，我们开发了一种新颖的函数型数据方法进行估计和推断，该方法考虑了预期分布的变化。我们发现这种变化可以用少数几个函数型因子来概括，并证明了它们对通胀动态的统计和经济相关性。我们的结果率先强调了在宏观经济结果研究中，对多样化信念进行严格处理可能为实证工作带来的潜在益处。

articles.title_en: The macroeconomic announcement premium and information environment
articles.title_cn: 宏观经济公告溢价与信息环境
articles.abstract_en: The quality of information environment has impact on the market risk premium and the expected risk reduction on macroeconomic announcement days. The risk premium is high when the risk is high as in standard asset pricing models, while the risk premium is low when the prevailing information environment is poor. The same is true for the expected risk reduction. These effects extend to market factor premiums (i.e., the premium associated with market betas) on various sets of portfolios and have a connection with business cycles. The findings are consistent with the notion that poor information environment hampers the effectiveness of learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息环境的质量对市场风险溢价和宏观经济公告日的预期风险降低有影响。当风险较高时，风险溢价较高，这与标准资产定价模型一致；而当现行信息环境较差时，风险溢价较低。预期风险降低也是如此。这些效应扩展到各种投资组合上的市场因子溢价（即与市场贝塔相关的溢价），并与商业周期有关。研究结果与信息环境差会阻碍学习有效性的观点一致。

articles.title_en: Financial crises and shadow banks: A quantitative analysis
articles.title_cn: 金融危机与影子银行：定量分析
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by the build-up of shadow bank leverage prior to the financial crisis of 2007–2008, I develop a nonlinear macroeconomic model featuring excessive leverage accumulation and endogenous runs to capture the dynamics and quantify the build-up of instability. Incorporating monetary policy, I demonstrate that the zero lower bound increases the crises frequency and lowers welfare. The model is taken to U.S. data to estimate the run probability around the financial crisis of 2007–2008. The estimated run risk was already considerable in 2005 and kept increasing. Counterfactual simulations evaluate whether monetary interventions boost welfare and could have averted the financial crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 受2007-2008年金融危机前影子银行杠杆累积的启发，我构建了一个包含过度杠杆累积和内生挤兑的非线性宏观经济模型，以捕捉动态变化并量化不稳定性的累积。纳入货币政策后，我证明了零利率下限增加了危机频率并降低了福利。该模型应用于美国数据，以估计2007-2008年金融危机前后的挤兑概率。估计的挤兑风险在2005年已经相当可观，并持续上升。反事实模拟评估了货币干预是否能提升福利并可能避免金融危机。

articles.title_cn: 信息不完全下的初创企业补贴
articles.abstract_en: How is firm creation affected by imperfect information? Our model of rational inattention generates inefficient entry and labor misallocation, because startups make error-prone decisions. Learning decisions of prospective entrepreneurs alter the effects of lump-sum transfers to startups: the total employment gain is amplified due to an unintended increase in inefficient entry, most entrants hire fewer workers, and misallocation goes up. The transfer changes the learning incentives and makes even productive startups lean towards more conservative hiring. We show that this novel information channel works against well-known mechanisms, and thus can help reconcile recent empirical evidence on startup policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业创建如何受到信息不完全的影响？我们的理性疏忽模型产生了无效率的进入和劳动力错配，因为初创企业会做出易错的决策。潜在企业家的学习决策改变了对初创企业一次性转移支付的效果：由于无效率进入的意外增加，总就业增长被放大，大多数进入者雇佣更少的工人，错配加剧。转移支付改变了学习激励，甚至使生产性初创企业倾向于更保守的雇佣。我们表明，这种新颖的信息渠道与众所周知的机制相悖，因此有助于调和关于初创企业政策的最新经验证据。

articles.title_en: Let's face it: Quantifying the impact of nonverbal communication in FOMC press conferences
articles.title_cn: 让我们面对现实：量化FOMC新闻发布会中非语言沟通的影响
articles.abstract_en: When the Fed Chair speaks, investors not only listen, but also watch. To demonstrate this phenomenon, we apply facial recognition analysis to FOMC press conference videos and quantify one of the most important aspects of nonverbal communication - facial expressions. Using minute-level data, we align our nonverbal communication measure with a set of financial assets to estimate the impact of the Fed Chairs’ facial expressions on investor expectations. We find that investors adversely react to negative expressions revealed during the press conference, even when controlling for the verbal component of the press conference and other explanatory variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 当美联储主席发言时，投资者不仅倾听，还会观察。为了证明这一现象，我们将面部识别分析应用于FOMC新闻发布会视频，并量化非语言沟通中最重要的方面之一——面部表情。利用分钟级数据，我们将非语言沟通度量与一系列金融资产对齐，以估计美联储主席面部表情对投资者预期的影响。我们发现，即使在控制新闻发布会的语言成分和其他解释变量后，投资者对发布会期间流露的负面表情也会产生不利反应。

articles.title_en: A model of retail banking and the deposits channel of monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 零售银行模型与货币政策的存款渠道
articles.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic, search-theoretic model of bank deposits markets where relationships are bilateral, the demand for liquid assets is microfounded, and consumers are privately informed about their liquidity needs. As the policy rate rises, the deposit spread widens, and aggregate deposits shrink, in accordance with the deposits channel documented in Drechsler et al. (2017). The deposit outflow originates from consumers in the lower percentiles of the distribution of deposits. As banks become more informed about consumers’ types (e.g., through big data), their market power increases but transmission weakens. As entry costs are reduced (e.g., through online banking), market power shrinks and transmission weakens.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个动态的、搜索理论的银行存款市场模型，其中关系是双边的，流动性资产的需求是微观基础的，消费者对其流动性需求拥有私人信息。随着政策利率上升，存款利差扩大，总存款收缩，这与Drechsler等人（2017）记录的存款渠道一致。存款外流源于存款分布较低百分位的消费者。随着银行对消费者类型的信息更加了解（例如，通过大数据），它们的市场势力增强，但传导减弱。随着进入成本的降低（例如，通过网上银行），市场势力缩小，传导减弱。
